/ close the issue, write the follow-up note
PROPOSAL. A box is a state: a label on GitHub (written without "cumin/status/").
Every guard reads only facts on GitHub and "no agent of cumin runs for this issue".
No arrow needs the event "the run ended": a restart of cumin loses nothing.
"merging" makes a merge whose answer was lost visible: the next poll reads whether the pull request is merged.
